llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent and asks for nothing sensitive, but it is instruction-only with no code, no homepage, and an unknown source. That means: (1) installing it will not add binaries but also provides no shipped implementation — verify where the agent will run the analyses (local code, platform-provided executor, or remote service). (2) Do not upload sensitive data in place of the CSV unless you trust the execution environment. (3) Ask the publisher for source or a homepage, or prefer a skill with a verifiable repository or release if you need stronger assurance. The metadata version mismatch (1.0.0 vs registry 1.0.36) is a minor red flag worth clarifying before wide deployment.
